newsitem.title: FRANCE: UPS France temporary switch to Nantes from Rennes.
newsitem.headline: UPS France temporary switch to Nantes from Rennes.

text.p: United Parcel Service of America France said there will be a temporary transfer of its weekday feeder Paris/CDG-Rennes air cargo service to Nantes airport at the start of next month.
"The service will be moved to Nantes between August 4-10 due to renovation work on the main runway at Rennes," a UPS official told Reuters.
UPS had told customers of the switch and did not expect it would mean any service disruption.
UPS previously used Nantes in its air cargo feeder network before choosing Rennes as the hub for traffic from western France traffic, he added.

The company operates the route with a 5.5 tonne cargo capacity Hawker-Siddeley 748 which is wet-leased from French airline, Air Littoral. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
